name: Ol-Kalou
eligibility_notes: Open to secondary and tertiary students whose parent or guardian resides in Ol-Kalou constituency. Priority is given to orphans, students with disabilities, and low-income households.

office.location: Ol Kalou town, opposite the sub-county offices

faqs.q: Can a student studying outside the county apply?
faqs.a: Yes. A parent or guardian resident in the constituency applies and tracks the application locally while the student stays in session.

faqs.q: Do I need to pay anything to apply?
faqs.a: No. NG-CDF bursary application is completely free. Report anyone asking for a fee to the CDF office.

name: Mwala
eligibility_notes: Open to secondary, college and university students from Mwala constituency. Priority to total and partial orphans and needy households.

office.location: Mwala town, NG-CDF offices along Wamunyu-Mwala road

faqs.q: Can I also apply on the Mwala online portal?
faqs.a: Yes, Mwala has an online portal, but paper applications at the CDF office are equally valid. Use whichever channel you can access.

name: Garissa Township
eligibility_notes: Open to secondary and tertiary students resident in Garissa Township. Priority to orphans, students with disabilities, and households affected by drought.

office.location: Garissa town, NG-CDF building near the county assembly

faqs.q: Is the application available in Kiswahili?
faqs.a: Yes. Forms and help are available in both Kiswahili and English at the CDF office, and this service supports both languages.

name: Kieni
eligibility_notes: Open to secondary and tertiary students from Kieni constituency. Priority to orphans and low-income households.

office.location: Kiganjo town, NG-CDF offices next to the DCC office

faqs.q: My child joined school mid-term. Can I still apply?
faqs.a: Yes, as long as the application window is open and you attach the admission letter and fee structure.

name: Mathira
eligibility_notes: Open to secondary, college and university students from Mathira constituency. Priority to orphans, students with disabilities, and needy households.

office.location: Karatina town, NG-CDF offices near the law courts

faqs.q: How will I know the outcome of my application?
faqs.a: You will receive an SMS when your status changes, and you can check anytime by dialling *123# and choosing Check Application Status.
